intro.heading: Where Tranquillity and Flavour Meet
paragraphs: There is a sense of timelessness in every dish; a timelessness that carries the breeze from an olive grove, the coolness of a cobbled street, and the humble words of an old recipe book…

Çi Neo Cucina draws inspiration from the simplest yet most profound flavours of the Mediterranean and Anatolia. We value the natural qualities of our ingredients, the warmth of the dining table, and the serene joy of sharing. Each of our recipes bears a trace of the seasons, the sea, the land and people’s stories.
We are not a restaurant; we wanted to be the very embodiment of gathering round a table woven with the voices of nature and tradition.
That is why Çi Neo Cucina is not merely a place to eat; it offers a timeless sense of camaraderie with every bite and a gentle Mediterranean breeze with every sip.
Welcome. Your seat is ready at our table.

vision.heading: Our Vision
paragraphs: In the gastronomy of the future, we aim to create a culinary language that is free from the clamour—one that is meaningful, sustainable and moving.
Çi Neo Cucina’s vision is to share with the world a culinary philosophy that spans from the local to the global—one that does not imitate nature but is in harmony with it.
Our greatest dream is to evolve, over time, from simply being a restaurant into a philosophy, a way of life.

chef.heading: Let’s Meet the Chef
paragraphs: Simge Manacıoğlu entered the corporate world after graduating from the Department of Political Science and International Relations at Yeditepe University. Although she went on to complete an MBA during this time, she never felt as though she belonged in that world.

Aged 30, she set out to turn her dream of establishing a winery – a dream she had nurtured since her first trip to Kaş in 2003 – into reality, with the support of her husband and mother. Her interest in gastronomy took a professional turn in 2014 with her training at the EKS Culinary Academy, which she completed as top of her class.

In 2016, she moved to Kaş and began working as a chef at ‘Sumanu Şarap Evi’, where she further honed her culinary skills. In 2018, she made history in Turkey by opening the restaurant ‘Mezeteryan’ with her husband,Tolga Manacıoğlu, introducing lionfish to the menu and raising awareness about sustainability. Over the course of four years, she collaborated with key organisations such as UNDP, WWF and Akdeniz Koruma.
As of 2024, she continues to share her creative and sustainable approach to gastronomy through ‘Çi Neo Cucina’, named after her daughter Çağıl İda, who brings joy and inspiration to her life.
